svg.aria-label: Without Comet: columns on disk, rows in between, columns again on disk
svg.title: Data journey without Comet: four rows from source file to target file
svg.text: Without Comet: columns on disk, rows in between, columns again on disk
Four lineitem rows through the job, illustrative values; one of them fails the filter

g.text: columnar: work done once per batch or per file
each column chunk: encoded pages (dictionary or plain), zstd-compressed; a row group holds one chunk per column
decompressed and decoded into Arrow buffers; Spark reads them through IcebergArrowColumnVector
each iteration reads four values, tests the date and multiplies two decimals through java.math.BigDecimal
sum is decimal(38,4): too wide for an 8-byte slot, so it is stored as bytes in the row's variable-length part
per row: Pmod(Murmur3Hash(l_orderkey), 200), then length + UnsafeRow bytes
illustration: both orders land in one reduce task; in a real run they may not
each row is split into per-column page buffers: the turn back to columns that the plan does not show
encoded pages, zstd; the driver then commits the file as part of a new snapshot of the table
